data.explanation: This is an invoice for electrical work done in your home: a new sub-distribution board (Unterverteilung) with residual-current and circuit breakers, labour and a call-out fee. Transfer €1,214.99 to the IBAN shown, quoting the invoice number, by the deadline shown. Check that the work and hours match what was done. The labour part may be deductible as a tradesperson service (Handwerkerleistung) in your tax return if you pay by bank transfer.
